description: Combining-mark stability (PDF-78). U+0301 has no precomposed form with 'x', so NFC must leave the pair decomposed; the U+00B4 band is the spacing-accent control that must NOT be folded into the base.
validation: expected_codepoints is what extraction returns; folding it through presentation_form_folding reproduces authored_codepoints exactly and in order. Both directions are re-checked by gen_extraction_sidecars.py --check.
